key_insight: Explainable deep reinforcement learning can optimize building energy management while making the control policy more transparent and trustworthy.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps residential buildings with PV and batteries lower electricity costs and improve operational decisions under dynamic prices, weather, and demand.
method: Train on-policy and off-policy DRL agents on an expanded state space with real-time, forecast, calendar, and weather inputs.
Compare A2C and PPO against off-policy methods for battery and energy management control.
Use post-hoc explanation techniques to interpret learned policies and decision behavior.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on both synthetic data and real-world Living Lab Energy Campus data, with A2C and PPO showing the best cumulative rewards and policy stability.
watch_item: Results may depend on data quality, forecast accuracy, and the specific building setup, so transfer to other sites should be validated carefully.
paper_title: Explainable Data-driven Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods for Optimal Energy Management in Buildings
